{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check how many rows have age = -1
age_minus_1 = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]

# Check the 'converted' status for these rows
converted_in_negative_age = age_minus_1['converted'].value_counts()

# Also check if any of these are in the 'converted' group
print("Rows with age = -1:", len(age_minus_1))
print("Converted status of those with age = -1:", converted_in_negative_age)

# Now, check if there are any other negative ages
other_negative_ages = df[df['customer_age'] < 0]
print("Other negative ages (if any):", len(other_negative_ages))"}
